title: Muir Woods, Golden Gate Bridge, and Sausalito Coastal Experience
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Easy loading / unloading for guests with limited mobility
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step away from the city’s bustle and into the serene beauty of the North Bay. This curated journey takes you from the heart of San Francisco, through the world’s most famous crooked street, and across the Golden Gate Bridge into the rugged landscapes of the Marin Headlands. Whether you’re standing at the edge of history at Battery Spencer or wandering beneath the ancient canopy of Muir Woods, this tour is designed for the San Francisco traveler seeking a deeper connection with California’s natural wonders in the backyard of The City, up and over the bridge.
